---- MODULE W4Od15m1p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, RingSize, Slots, Orders, MaxToken, MaxOverrides, NoOrder

\* The token goes to the next seat or the one past it, so a quiet member does not
\* hold the whole auction up.
Onward(m, k) == ((m + k - 1) % RingSize) + 1

VARIABLES occupant, freeList, token, seat, overrides

vars == <<occupant, freeList, token, seat, overrides>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ occupant \in [Slots -> {NoOrder} \cup Orders]
    /\ freeList \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ token \in 1..MaxToken
    /\ seat \in [Members -> 0..MaxToken]
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
    /\ occupant = [s \in Slots |-> NoOrder]
    /\ freeList = Slots
    /\ token = 1
    /\ seat = [m \in Members |-> IF m = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ overrides = 0

Unplaced(o) == \A s \in Slots : occupant[s] # o

\* Both views move together: off the free list and onto the slot record.
Award(s, o) ==
    /\ s \in freeList
    /\ Unplaced(o)
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ freeList' = freeList \ {s}

Fill(m, s, o) ==
    /\ seat[m] = token
    /\ Award(s, o)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat, overrides>>

Override(s, o) ==
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ Award(s, o)
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ occupant[s] # NoOrder
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
    /\ freeList' = freeList \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seat, overrides>>

Pass(m, k) ==
    /\ seat[m] = token
    /\ token < MaxToken
    /\ token' = token + 1
    /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![m] = 0, ![Onward(m, k)] = token + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, freeList, overrides>>

ReForm(m) ==
    /\ token = MaxToken
    /\ token' = 1
    /\ seat' = [x \in Members |-> IF x = m THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, freeList, overrides>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members, s \in Slots, o \in Orders : Fill(m, s, o)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, o \in Orders : Override(s, o)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ \E m \in Members, k \in 1..2 : Pass(m, k)
    \/ \E m \in Members : ReForm(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FreeListMatchesBoard ==
    \A s \in Slots : (s \in freeList) <=> (occupant[s] = NoOrder)

====
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction hands out matching slots to orders. The auction keeps two
views of the slot board: a free list of the slots still available, and a per-slot record of
which order occupies it. The right to hand out a slot travels the matching members as a
numbered token, and a member may hand out a slot only while the token number it is holding is
the ring's current number; the token may be passed to the next member or the one past it, and
when the numbering runs out the ring is re-formed with a member seated at the first number.

The market supervisor holds a privileged override and may hand out a slot without the token
at all, a bounded number of times per auction. The override skips the ring but not the slot
board: the supervisor still has to take the slot off the free list and record its occupant,
exactly as a member would.

The auction behaves as follows. A member holding the ring's current token number may fill a
free slot with an order that does not already occupy a slot, which takes the slot off the
free list and records the order against it. The supervisor may do the same without holding
the token, spending one of the auction's overrides. An occupied slot may be released, which
clears its occupant and puts it back on the free list. A member holding the current token
number may pass the token to the next member or the one past it, taking the next number. When
the numbering is spent, a member may re-form the ring, restarting the numbering with itself
seated and every other member holding nothing.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A slot is on the free list exactly when it has no occupant recorded against
it, so a slot can never be handed out twice nor stranded off the free list unfilled.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm, MaxEntries, NoOne

VARIABLES leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted

vars == <<leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes
    /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm
    /\ inside \in SUBSET Nodes
    /\ nominee \in {NoOne} \cup Nodes
    /\ stoodAside \in BOOLEAN
    /\ posted \in 0..MaxEntries

Init ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes
    /\ term = 1
    /\ inside = {}
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ stoodAside = FALSE
    /\ posted = 0

\* A nomination closes the window to new entries; nothing is yanked away from
\* whoever is already in there.
Enter(n) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ n \notin inside
    /\ inside' = inside \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Post(n) ==
    /\ n \in inside
    /\ posted < MaxEntries
    /\ posted' = posted + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, nominee, stoodAside>>

StepOut(n) ==
    /\ n \in inside
    /\ inside' = inside \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Nominate(c) ==
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ c # leader
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ nominee' = c
    /\ stoodAside' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, posted>>

\* Standing aside is the slow step: it may take as long as it likes, but the
\* incumbent has to be out of the window before it can happen.
StandAside ==
    /\ nominee # NoOne
    /\ ~stoodAside
    /\ leader \notin inside
    /\ stoodAside' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, inside, nominee, posted>>

Install ==
    /\ nominee # NoOne
    /\ stoodAside
    /\ leader' = nominee
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ nominee' = NoOne
    /\ stoodAside' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inside, posted>>

Restart ==
    /\ term = MaxTerm
    /\ nominee = NoOne
    /\ term' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, inside, nominee, stoodAside, posted>>

Leaving == \E n \in Nodes : StepOut(n)

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n) \/ Post(n)
    \/ Leaving
    \/ \E c \in Nodes : Nominate(c)
    \/ StandAside
    \/ Install
    \/ Restart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ WF_vars(Leaving) /\ WF_vars(StandAside) /\ WF_vars(Install)

OnlyLeaderInWindow == \A n \in Nodes : n \in inside => n = leader

EveryNominationResolves == (nominee # NoOne) ~> (nominee = NoOne)

====

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {bnkClearing, bnkCorresp, bnkAgent}
    MaxTerm = 3
    MaxEntries = 2
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT OnlyLeaderInWindow
PROPERTY EveryNominationResolves
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch posts entries through a single settlement window that
only one node may be inside at a time. Which node that is is decided by leader election: the
elected node holds the window for its term, and a handover installs a successor at the next
term. Nodes can be slow but never fail, so a step a node owes the batch may take arbitrarily
long yet always eventually happens.

A handover is not allowed to yank the window out from under the incumbent. Once a successor
has been nominated the window is closed to new entries, the incumbent finishes what it is
doing and steps outside, and only then does it stand aside. The successor is installed only
after that standing-aside, and installation takes the batch to the next term. When the term
numbering is spent and no nomination is outstanding, the numbering restarts.

The batch behaves as follows. The node that is leader may enter the settlement window while
no nomination is outstanding and it is not already inside. A node inside the window may post
an entry, so long as the batch's entry allowance is not spent. A node inside the window may
step outside. Any node other than the leader may be nominated as successor while no
nomination is outstanding and the term numbering is not spent, which closes the window to new
entries. The incumbent may stand aside once it is outside the window and a nomination is
outstanding. The nominated successor is installed once the incumbent has stood aside, which
makes it leader and takes the batch to the next term. When the term numbering is spent and no
nomination is outstanding, the numbering may be restarted.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every node inside the settlement window is the current leader, so two nodes
are never inside it at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every nomination is eventually resolved, leaving no nomination
outstanding.

---- MODULE W4Od8m0p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Advisers, Courses, MaxVersion, MaxSeats, NoOne

VARIABLES version, draftBy, draftStamp, entitled, seats

vars == <<version, draftBy, draftStamp, entitled, seats>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in [Courses -> 0..MaxVersion]
    /\ draftBy \in [Courses -> {NoOne} \cup Advisers]
    /\ draftStamp \in [Courses -> 0..MaxVersion]
    /\ entitled \in SUBSET Advisers
    /\ seats \in [Courses -> 0..MaxSeats]

Init ==
    /\ version = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ draftBy = [c \in Courses |-> NoOne]
    /\ draftStamp = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ entitled = Advisers
    /\ seats = [c \in Courses |-> 0]

TakeDraft(a, c) ==
    /\ a \in entitled
    /\ draftBy[c] = NoOne
    /\ draftBy' = [draftBy EXCEPT ![c] = a]
    /\ draftStamp' = [draftStamp EXCEPT ![c] = version[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, entitled, seats>>

Commit(a, c, s) ==
    /\ draftBy[c] = a
    /\ draftStamp[c] = version[c]
    /\ a \in entitled
    /\ version[c] < MaxVersion
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ draftBy' = [draftBy EXCEPT ![c] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<draftStamp, entitled>>

Abandon(c) ==
    /\ draftBy[c] # NoOne
    /\ draftBy' = [draftBy EXCEPT ![c] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, draftStamp, entitled, seats>>

\* A suspension has to take the adviser's drafts with it; a draft nobody stands
\* behind is exactly the stale claim this system is trying not to honour.
Suspend(a) ==
    /\ a \in entitled
    /\ entitled' = entitled \ {a}
    /\ draftBy' = [c \in Courses |-> IF draftBy[c] = a THEN NoOne ELSE draftBy[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, draftStamp, seats>>

Reinstate(a) ==
    /\ a \notin entitled
    /\ entitled' = entitled \cup {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, draftBy, draftStamp, seats>>

\* Reindexing would make an old stamp read as current again, so it voids the
\* draft standing on that record.
Reindex(c) ==
    /\ version[c] = MaxVersion
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
    /\ draftBy' = [draftBy EXCEPT ![c] = NoOne]
    /\ draftStamp' = [draftStamp EXCEPT ![c] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<entitled, seats>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Advisers, c \in Courses : TakeDraft(a, c)
    \/ \E a \in Advisers, c \in Courses, s \in 0..MaxSeats : Commit(a, c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Abandon(c) \/ Reindex(c)
    \/ \E a \in Advisers : Suspend(a) \/ Reinstate(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DraftsAreEntitledAndCurrent ==
    \A c \in Courses :
        draftBy[c] # NoOne => (draftBy[c] \in entitled /\ draftStamp[c] = version[c])

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Advisers = {advDean, advRegistry}
    Courses = {crsLogic, crsOptics}
    MaxVersion = 2
    MaxSeats = 2
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT DraftsAreEntitledAndCurrent
nl:
A university course-registration system lets advisers change a course's seat count under
optimistic locking. An adviser first takes out a draft on the course, which records the
adviser as the draft's holder and stamps it with the course record's current version. The
adviser then works out the change and commits it, which is accepted only if the stamp on the
draft is still the record's version and the adviser is still entitled to register changes.
Committing writes the new seat count and moves the record's version on.

Advisers can be slow but never disappear: a draft may sit open for as long as the adviser
takes. What can change underneath it is entitlement. The registrar may suspend an adviser at
any moment, and a suspension voids every draft that adviser is holding on the spot, because a
suspended adviser's draft is a claim on the record that nobody stands behind any more. A
suspended adviser may later be reinstated. When a course record's version numbering is spent
it is reindexed back to the start, and reindexing likewise voids any draft standing on that
record, since the stamp it carries would otherwise read as current again.

The system behaves as follows. An entitled adviser may take out a draft on a course that has
no draft standing, stamped with that record's current version. An adviser holding a draft
whose stamp is still current, and who is still entitled, may commit a new seat count while the
record's version numbering has room, which writes the seat count, moves the version on, and
clears the draft. Any standing draft may be abandoned. The registrar may suspend an entitled
adviser, voiding every draft that adviser holds. The registrar may reinstate a suspended
adviser. A course record whose version numbering is spent may be reindexed, which returns its
version to the start and voids any draft standing on it.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every course carrying a standing draft has that draft held by an adviser who
is still entitled and stamped with that record's current version, so no draft on the record is
ever left in the hands of a suspended adviser or built on a version that has moved on.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Techs, MaxEpoch, MinCapacity, MaxCapacity, NoOne

VARIABLES epoch, roster, bench, working, capacity, stored

vars == <<epoch, roster, bench, working, capacity, stored>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ roster \in SUBSET Techs
    /\ bench \in {NoOne} \cup Techs
    /\ working \in SUBSET Techs
    /\ capacity \in MinCapacity..MaxCapacity
    /\ stored \in 0..MaxCapacity

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ roster = Techs
    /\ bench = NoOne
    /\ working = {}
    /\ capacity = MinCapacity
    /\ stored = 0

Claim(t) ==
    /\ t \in roster
    /\ bench = NoOne
    /\ stored < capacity
    /\ bench' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, working, capacity, stored>>

Begin(t) ==
    /\ bench = t
    /\ t \notin working
    /\ working' = working \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, bench, capacity, stored>>

Finish(t) ==
    /\ t \in working
    /\ stored < capacity
    /\ working' = working \ {t}
    /\ bench' = NoOne
    /\ stored' = stored + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, capacity>>

Issue ==
    /\ stored > 0
    /\ stored' = stored - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, bench, working, capacity>>

\* Retuning may leave the store over its new capacity; nothing more goes in until
\* it has been drawn back down.
Retune(v) ==
    /\ v # capacity
    /\ capacity' = v
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, bench, working, stored>>

\* Reconfiguring under a working technician would strand it off the roster, so it
\* is only allowed with the bench idle.
Reconfigure(r) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ r # roster
    /\ bench = NoOne
    /\ working = {}
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ roster' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bench, working, capacity, stored>>

Renumber ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ bench = NoOne
    /\ working = {}
    /\ epoch' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<roster, bench, working, capacity, stored>>

Beginning == \E t \in Techs : Begin(t)
Finishing == \E t \in Techs : Finish(t)

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Techs : Claim(t)
    \/ Beginning
    \/ Finishing
    \/ Issue
    \/ \E v \in MinCapacity..MaxCapacity : Retune(v)
    \/ \E r \in SUBSET Techs : Reconfigure(r)
    \/ Renumber

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ WF_vars(Beginning) /\ SF_vars(Finishing) /\ WF_vars(Issue)

BenchExclusion ==
    \A t \in Techs : t \in working => (bench = t /\ t \in roster)

EveryClaimIsGivenUp == (bench # NoOne) ~> (bench = NoOne)

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Techs = {tecCross, tecTyping, tecIssue}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MinCapacity = 1
    MaxCapacity = 2
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT BenchExclusion
PROPERTY EveryClaimIsGivenUp
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker has one cross-match bench that a single technician may occupy
at a time. Which technicians are on duty is settled by an epoch-numbered reconfiguration: each
epoch carries a roster, and only a technician on the current roster may take the bench. A
reconfiguration is only allowed between bench sessions, when the bench is free and nobody is
working at it, because a roster change that took effect under a technician's hands would leave
someone working at the bench with no standing to be there.

The bank's cold-store capacity is set at runtime and may be retuned up or down at any moment.
A technician takes the bench only when the store has room for the unit the session will
produce, and finishing a session puts that unit into the store. Units are issued out of the
store as demand comes in.

The tracker behaves as follows. A technician on the current roster may claim the free bench,
provided the store has room. A technician the bench is claimed for may begin work at it. A
technician at work may finish, provided the store still has room, which puts a unit into the
store, takes the technician off the bench and frees it. A unit may be issued out of the store
whenever the store is not empty. The store's capacity may be retuned to any value in the
bank's permitted range, including below what the store is already holding, in which case the
store simply takes nothing more until it has been drawn down. The roster may be reconfigured
to any different roster while the bench is free and nobody is working, which takes the tracker
to the next epoch. When the epoch numbering is spent and the bench is idle, the numbering
restarts.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every technician at work is the technician the bench is claimed for and is on
the current roster, so two technicians can never be working the bench at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every claim on the bench is eventually given up, leaving the bench free
again.

---- MODULE W4Od5m8p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Lobbies, Roster, SeatLimit, NoOne

VARIABLES region, lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated, dead

vars == <<region, lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated, dead>>

RECURSIVE SumOf(_, _)
SumOf(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOf(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ region \in {NoOne} \cup Nodes
    /\ lobbyLock \in [Lobbies -> {NoOne} \cup Nodes]
    /\ pool \in 0..Roster
    /\ holding \in [Lobbies -> 0..Roster]
    /\ seated \in [Lobbies -> 0..Roster]
    /\ dead \in SUBSET Nodes

Init ==
    /\ region = NoOne
    /\ lobbyLock = [l \in Lobbies |-> NoOne]
    /\ pool = Roster
    /\ holding = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ seated = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ dead = {}

TakeRegion(n) ==
    /\ n \notin dead
    /\ region = NoOne
    /\ region' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated, dead>>

\* Taking the fine lock hands the coarse one straight back.
TakeLobby(n, l) ==
    /\ region = n
    /\ n \notin dead
    /\ lobbyLock[l] = NoOne
    /\ lobbyLock' = [lobbyLock EXCEPT ![l] = n]
    /\ region' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, holding, seated, dead>>

Draw(n, l) ==
    /\ lobbyLock[l] = n
    /\ n \notin dead
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, lobbyLock, seated, dead>>

Seat(n, l) ==
    /\ lobbyLock[l] = n
    /\ n \notin dead
    /\ holding[l] > 0
    /\ seated[l] < SeatLimit
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, lobbyLock, pool, dead>>

ReleaseLobby(n, l) ==
    /\ lobbyLock[l] = n
    /\ holding[l] = 0
    /\ lobbyLock' = [lobbyLock EXCEPT ![l] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, pool, holding, seated, dead>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin dead
    /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Nodes) - 1
    /\ dead' = dead \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated>>

Restart(n) ==
    /\ n \in dead
    /\ dead' = dead \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated>>

\* Reclaiming has to put the holding area back, or the players drawn into it are
\* stranded behind a lock nobody holds.
ReclaimLobby(l) ==
    /\ lobbyLock[l] \in dead
    /\ lobbyLock' = [lobbyLock EXCEPT ![l] = NoOne]
    /\ pool' = pool + holding[l]
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![l] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, seated, dead>>

ReclaimRegion ==
    /\ region \in dead
    /\ region' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lobbyLock, pool, holding, seated, dead>>

LeaveMatch(l) ==
    /\ seated[l] > 0
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, lobbyLock, holding, dead>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : TakeRegion(n) \/ Crash(n) \/ Restart(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, l \in Lobbies :
          TakeLobby(n, l) \/ Draw(n, l) \/ Seat(n, l) \/ ReleaseLobby(n, l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : ReclaimLobby(l) \/ LeaveMatch(l)
    \/ ReclaimRegion

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PlayersConserved ==
    pool + SumOf(holding, Lobbies) + SumOf(seated, Lobbies) = Roster

====

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {mmAlpha, mmBravo}
    Lobbies = {lbyDuel, lbySquad}
    Roster = 2
    SeatLimit = 2
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT PlayersConserved
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker moves players between a region-wide free pool and its
lobbies. The roster of players is fixed: a player is always accounted for in exactly one of
three places -- waiting in the free pool, drawn into a lobby's holding area, or seated in a
lobby -- and the matchmaker must never mislay one between them.

Moving players is protected by a two-level lock. A matchmaker node first takes the region
lock, which is coarse and held by one node at a time, and uses it to take the fine lock on a
single lobby; taking the lobby lock hands the region lock back. Only the holder of a lobby's
fine lock may draw players into that lobby's holding area or seat them from it.

A matchmaker node can crash silently, so the rest cannot tell a dead node from a slow one and
its locks have to be reclaimed. Reclaiming a lobby lock from a crashed node also empties that
lobby's holding area back into the free pool, because players drawn but never seated would
otherwise be stranded in a holding area nobody holds the lock to.

The matchmaker behaves as follows. A live node may take the free region lock. A node holding
the region lock may take the fine lock on an unlocked lobby, which hands the region lock back.
A node holding a lobby's fine lock may draw a player out of the free pool into that lobby's
holding area while the pool is not empty. It may seat a player from that holding area while
the holding area is not empty and the lobby is below its seat limit. It may release the lobby
lock once the holding area is empty. Any node may crash silently, so long as not every node
has crashed, and a crashed node may later come back. A lobby lock held by a crashed node may be
reclaimed, which empties that lobby's holding area back into the free pool. The region lock
held by a crashed node may likewise be reclaimed. A seated player may leave, returning to the
free pool.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The free pool, the lobby holding areas and the lobby seats always account
between them for exactly the fixed roster of players, so no player is ever created or lost.

---- MODULE W4Od11m6p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Presses, Jobs, Capacity, Horizon, MaxOffers

\* An offer names a job, a press and the deadline the reservation would carry;
\* offers overtake one another, so all three can be out of date on arrival.
Offers == [job : Jobs, press : Presses, until : 1..Horizon]

VARIABLES clock, reserved, deadline, mounted, circulating

vars == <<clock, reserved, deadline, mounted, circulating>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..Horizon
    /\ reserved \in [Presses -> SUBSET Jobs]
    /\ deadline \in [Jobs -> 0..Horizon]
    /\ mounted \in [Presses -> SUBSET Jobs]
    /\ circulating \in SUBSET Offers

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ reserved = [p \in Presses |-> {}]
    /\ deadline = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ mounted = [p \in Presses |-> {}]
    /\ circulating = {}

\* What a press is committed to is reservations and mountings together.
Committed(p) == Cardinality(reserved[p] \cup mounted[p])

Placed(j) == \E p \in Presses : j \in reserved[p] \/ j \in mounted[p]

Circulate(o) ==
    /\ o \notin circulating
    /\ Cardinality(circulating) < MaxOffers
    /\ circulating' = circulating \cup {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, reserved, deadline, mounted>>

Usable(o) == o.until > clock /\ ~Placed(o.job) /\ Committed(o.press) < Capacity

TakeUp(o) ==
    /\ o \in circulating
    /\ Usable(o)
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![o.press] = @ \cup {o.job}]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![o.job] = o.until]
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, mounted>>

TurnAway(o) ==
    /\ o \in circulating
    /\ ~Usable(o)
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, reserved, deadline, mounted>>

\* Mounting converts a reservation into a mounting, so the press's commitment is
\* unchanged by it.
Mount(j, p) ==
    /\ j \in reserved[p]
    /\ deadline[j] > clock
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![p] = @ \ {j}]
    /\ mounted' = [mounted EXCEPT ![p] = @ \cup {j}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, deadline, circulating>>

TakeOff(j, p) ==
    /\ j \in mounted[p]
    /\ mounted' = [mounted EXCEPT ![p] = @ \ {j}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, reserved, deadline, circulating>>

Sweep(j, p) ==
    /\ j \in reserved[p]
    /\ deadline[j] <= clock
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![p] = @ \ {j}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, deadline, mounted, circulating>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < Horizon
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, deadline, mounted, circulating>>

NewSession ==
    /\ clock = Horizon
    /\ \A p \in Presses : reserved[p] = {}
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ circulating' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, deadline, mounted>>

Sweeping == \E j \in Jobs, p \in Presses : Sweep(j, p)

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Offers : Circulate(o) \/ TakeUp(o) \/ TurnAway(o)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Presses : Mount(j, p) \/ TakeOff(j, p)
    \/ Sweeping
    \/ Tick
    \/ NewSession

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Tick) /\ WF_vars(Sweeping)

WithinPressCapacity == \A p \in Presses : Committed(p) <= Capacity

ExpiredReservationsSwept ==
    \A j \in Jobs, p \in Presses :
        (j \in reserved[p] /\ deadline[j] <= clock) ~> (j \notin reserved[p])

====

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Presses = {prsWeb, prsSheet}
    Jobs = {jobPoster, jobBooklet}
    Capacity = 1
    Horizon = 2
    MaxOffers = 2

INVARIANT WithinPressCapacity
PROPERTY ExpiredReservationsSwept
nl:
A print shop job spooler assigns jobs to presses. A press has a fixed capacity counting
everything it is committed to: jobs holding a reservation on it and jobs actually mounted on
it together may never exceed that capacity. A reservation is a lease with a deadline on the
shop clock; when the deadline passes the reservation is swept away and the capacity it was
holding comes back.

Reservation offers reach the presses out of order and can be arbitrarily late, so an offer may
arrive after its own deadline has already passed, or after the press it names has filled up,
or after the job it names has been placed somewhere else. An offer is taken up only if its
deadline is still ahead of the clock, its job is not already reserved or mounted anywhere, and
the press it names is below capacity; any offer failing those tests is turned away. The
spooler keeps only a bounded number of offers in circulation at a time.

The spooler behaves as follows. The spooler may put an offer into circulation naming a job, a
press and a deadline, so long as the circulation limit is not reached. A circulating offer that
passes all three tests is taken up, reserving that press for that job until the offer's
deadline. A circulating offer that fails any of them is turned away. A job holding a
reservation whose deadline is still ahead may be mounted on that press, which converts the
reservation into a mounting without changing what the press is committed to. A mounted job may
be finished and taken off. A reservation whose deadline has passed may be swept away. The clock
may tick. When the clock has run out and no reservations are standing, the shop may start a
fresh session, returning the clock to the start and clearing every offer in circulation.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every press, the jobs holding a reservation on it together with the jobs
mounted on it never number more than the press's capacity.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every reservation whose deadline has passed is eventually swept off the
press holding it.

---- MODULE W4Od18m0p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Installers, Guests, MaxVersion, MinLimit, MaxLimit, NoOne, NoStage

\* A staged addition carries the list version it was read against; that stamp is
\* what optimistic locking checks before the addition is allowed to land.
Stagings == [guest : Guests, base : 0..MaxVersion]

VARIABLES list, sponsor, authorised, version, limit, staged

vars == <<list, sponsor, authorised, version, limit, staged>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ list \in SUBSET Guests
    /\ sponsor \in [Guests -> {NoOne} \cup Installers]
    /\ authorised \in SUBSET Installers
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVersion
    /\ limit \in MinLimit..MaxLimit
    /\ staged \in [Installers -> {NoStage} \cup Stagings]

Init ==
    /\ list = {}
    /\ sponsor = [g \in Guests |-> NoOne]
    /\ authorised = Installers
    /\ version = 0
    /\ limit = MinLimit
    /\ staged = [i \in Installers |-> NoStage]

Stage(i, g) ==
    /\ i \in authorised
    /\ staged[i] = NoStage
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = [guest |-> g, base |-> version]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<list, sponsor, authorised, version, limit>>

Landable(i) ==
    /\ i \in authorised
    /\ staged[i].base = version
    /\ Cardinality(list) < limit
    /\ staged[i].guest \notin list
    /\ version < MaxVersion

Commit(i) ==
    /\ staged[i] # NoStage
    /\ Landable(i)
    /\ list' = list \cup {staged[i].guest}
    /\ sponsor' = [sponsor EXCEPT ![staged[i].guest] = i]
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorised, limit>>

StartOver(i) ==
    /\ staged[i] # NoStage
    /\ ~Landable(i)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![i] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<list, sponsor, authorised, version, limit>>

\* Withdrawing standing takes the installer's guests with it; a guest nobody
\* accountable put there has no business staying on the list.
Withdraw(i) ==
    /\ i \in authorised
    /\ authorised' = authorised \ {i}
    /\ list' = list \ {g \in Guests : sponsor[g] = i}
    /\ sponsor' = [g \in Guests |-> IF sponsor[g] = i THEN NoOne ELSE sponsor[g]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, limit, staged>>

Authorise(i) ==
    /\ i \notin authorised
    /\ authorised' = authorised \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<list, sponsor, version, limit, staged>>

Retune(v) ==
    /\ v # limit
    /\ limit' = v
    /\ UNCHANGED <<list, sponsor, authorised, version, staged>>

Reindex ==
    /\ version = MaxVersion
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ staged' = [i \in Installers |-> NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<list, sponsor, authorised, limit>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Installers, g \in Guests : Stage(i, g)
    \/ \E i \in Installers : Commit(i) \/ StartOver(i)
    \/ \E i \in Installers : Withdraw(i) \/ Authorise(i)
    \/ \E v \in MinLimit..MaxLimit : Retune(v)
    \/ Reindex

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SponsorsStillStand ==
    \A g \in Guests : g \in list => sponsor[g] \in authorised

nl:
A smart-home door lock network keeps a guest access list. Guests are added by installer
sessions working under optimistic locking: an installer stages the guest it intends to add
together with the list's version as it read it, and the staged addition is only committed if
that version is still the list's version when the commit is attempted. Otherwise the staged
addition is thrown away and the installer has to start over. Every guest on the list is
recorded against the installer that sponsored it.

How many guests the list may hold is set at runtime and the homeowner may retune it up or
down at any moment. A retune downwards is allowed even when the list already holds more
guests than the new figure; the list simply accepts nothing further until it is back under
the limit.

Installer authorisation is not permanent. The homeowner may withdraw an installer's
authorisation, and withdrawing it strikes from the list every guest that installer sponsored,
because a guest whose sponsor no longer has standing has nobody accountable for it. A
withdrawn installer may be authorised again later.

The network behaves as follows. An authorised installer with nothing staged may stage a guest,
recording the list's version as it stands. An installer may commit its staged addition when it
is still authorised, the version it staged against is still the list's version, the list is
below its current limit, the guest is not already on the list, and the version numbering has
room; committing puts the guest on the list, records the installer as its sponsor and moves the
version on. A staged addition that fails any of those tests is thrown away and the installer
starts over. The homeowner may withdraw an installer's authorisation, striking every guest that
installer sponsored off the list. The homeowner may authorise a withdrawn installer. The
homeowner may retune the list's limit anywhere in the network's permitted range. When the
version numbering is spent it is reindexed to the start, which also throws away every staged
addition, since the version they staged against would otherwise read as current again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every guest on the access list is recorded against a sponsor that is still an
authorised installer, so no guest ever remains admitted on the strength of an installer that
has lost its standing.
